headline: US Dollar Hovers Near 22-Month Peak Amid AI Trade Doubts and Rate Bets
summary: The US dollar held near a 22-month peak in holiday-thinned trading, supported by safe-haven demand and rate-hike bets as AI trade doubts triggered equity volatility.
why: The US dollar index serves as the premier gauge of global liquidity and risk sentiment, influencing capital flows across emerging markets and commodity pricing.

impacts.name: US Dollar Index
impacts.why: Safe-haven demand and rate hike expectations kept the dollar index steady near 22-month highs.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Persistent investor anxiety over artificial intelligence valuations and expectations of US interest rate hikes drove strong safe-haven demand for the dollar.
